name: Admission supervisor
design: Short heavy female adult with reddish olive mottled skin, low rounded exposed mandible face, short thick dreadlocks in rear bun. Practical mustard tunic under long brown leather tabard, black shoulder roll, wide belt with separate pouches for small unmarked metal entry tokens, ankle wraps. Holds a compact token dispenser at waist with both hands; sturdy welcoming stance.
